[B2] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : DeviceX , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'openWindow' cloudA | DeviceX
=> < UserX | 'key' : FreshKey , ... > < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : DeviceX , ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'openWindow' DeviceX | FreshKey .

[B2] < DeviceX | 'key' : nils , ... > $ cloudA 'openWindow' DeviceX | Key
=> < DeviceX | 'key' : Key , ... > .

[B3] < DeviceX | 'key' : Key , 'trusted' : Trusted , ... > $ UserX 'bind' DeviceX | Key
=> < DeviceX | 'key' : Key , 'trusted' : (UserX , Trusted) , ... > .

[B4] < DeviceX | 'trusted' : (UserX , Trusted) , 'on' : false , ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' DeviceX
=> < DeviceX | 'trusted' : (UserX , Trusted) , 'on' : true , ... > .

[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : DeviceX , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' cloudA
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : DeviceX , ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'turnOn' DeviceX .

[B5] < DeviceX | 'trusted' : (cloudA , Trusted) , 'on' : false , ... > $ cloudA 'turnOn' DeviceX
=> < DeviceX | 'trusted' : (cloudA , Trusted) , 'on' : true , ... > .

[B6] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , 'device' : DeviceX , ...) , UserY : ('device' : DeviceX , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'removeMember' cloudA | UserY
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : DeviceX , ...) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ... > .
